scope.task: six-option activity classification over one 128-sample sensor window
scope.fit_split: official train split only, with deterministic participant-disjoint train/validation partition
scope.official_test_policy: parse once only after candidate configs and checkpoints are hash-frozen; public development reference, not blind audit
